title: Research problem for candidate-dag-selection-v1
goal: Validate the research basis for building candidate DAG selection as the next planner/runtime slice.
problem_statement: Should Jaysearch build a conservative candidate DAG selector before autonomous DAG generation?
constraints: do not generate DAGs autonomously in V1

repo_context.decision_target: authorize conservative candidate DAG selection before candidate DAG generation
repo_context.decision_consequence: determines whether Jaysearch should build a conservative supplied-DAG selector before autonomous DAG generation
repo_context.blocked_work_if_unanswered: cannot safely build DAG orchestration and selection without a scoped validation target

research_context.evidence_summary: Candidate DAG selection should be built as a bounded ingest/evaluate/select loop before autonomous DAG generation.
